== IPV6 SYNTAX PROBE — bracketed vs unbracketed entries in allowedDomains ==
$ srt --settings /tmp/s-ipv6-bracketed.json -c "echo hi"   # ["[::1]", "[2001:db8::1]:443"]
hi
exit code: 0

$ srt --settings /tmp/s-ipv6-bare.json -c "echo hi"        # ["2001:db8::1"] — unbracketed, multi-colon
Invalid configuration in /tmp/s-ipv6-bare.json:
  - network.allowedDomains.0: Invalid domain pattern. Must be a valid domain (e.g., "example.com"), a wildcard (e.g., "*.example.com"), or a bracketed IPv6 literal (e.g., "[::1]", "[2001:db8::1]:443"). Overly broad patterns like "*.com" or "*" are not allowed for security reasons. An optional ":port" suffix (1-65535) restricts the entry to that port.
Error: Could not load settings from /tmp/s-ipv6-bare.json (missing, unreadable, or invalid). Refusing to run with the default config.
exit code: 1
